question: Can the existing FlashInfer KV-index producer emit the sliding-window mapping directly, avoiding both the per-step host scalar read and the rejected capacity-wide translation kernel?

closed_iteration.interpretation: The scalar boundary was removed, but scanning the fixed 32736-element workspace every decode step cost more than the synchronization it replaced.

iteration2.causal_change: Fuse the full-to-SWA mapping into create_flashinfer_kv_indices_triton, or equivalently produce already-translated valid indices with work proportional to the device-known valid count; do not launch another capacity-wide pass.
iteration2.predicted_counter_change: Keep four-byte D2H predecessors at zero while eliminating the rejected fixed-capacity translation traffic and launch; combined producer-plus-translation GPU time and compulsory bytes must not exceed the retained producer-plus-stock-gather path.
iteration2.measurement: One exact-producer/consumer component and exactly one profiler-off c32 control/candidate pair, plus only the minimum trace or kernel counters needed to prove the fused path and absence of host scalar reads.
